reason: A Feishu/Lark integration bridge that connects chats to dedicated DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, supports streaming reply cards and tool-call approvals, and manages persistent sessions and long-lived connections.

summaries.zh: 将飞书聊天接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体会话，并提供流式回复卡片、工具调用审批及会话管理。
summaries.en: Connects Feishu chats to dedicated DeepSeek Harness agent sessions with streaming reply cards, tool-call approvals, and session management.

capabilities: Connects to Feishu via an official WebSocket SDK
Receives Feishu messages and routes them to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions
Sends streaming cards, text replies, reactions, and proactive agent messages to Feishu
Persists per-chat session state and configuration on the local filesystem
Runs helper subprocesses with automatic restart and reconnect behavior
Presents approval cards that submit allow or reject decisions for tool calls
